tests: tests/e2e/app.spec.ts::a peer connection cannot be made inside a canvas frame
tests/unit/canvas.test.ts::canvas origin > serves only canvas files, read-only, with a policy that allows scripts and no fetch, XHR or WebSocket
findings.note: at a later head, a canvas page loaded directly (not in the card) recovers a native peer connection through an empty child frame; the unit test only checks the guard text and the browser test only the in-card case, and this depends on browser platform behaviour that a base-failing unit test would not reproduce

tests: tests/unit/canvas.test.ts::the prelude > goes inside <head>, else after <html>, else first, and never changes a non-HTML file
findings.note: the guard is placed at the first head tag even when it sits inside an HTML comment, so a page can comment the guard out; the prelude test has no commented-head case, though such a case added to it would fail on base (no prelude) and at head, so it would expose this

tests: tests/unit/canvas.test.ts::canvas origin > serves only canvas files, read-only, with a policy that allows scripts and no fetch, XHR or WebSocket
findings.note: SVG files served on the canvas origin can run scripts but get no guard (only HTML does); the origin test covers HTML only, and an adjacent SVG case would be needed to expose it
